headlines.description: — Wendell Carter Jr. made a go-ahead dunk with 1.4 seconds left, and the Orlando Magic beat the Dallas Mavericks 115-114 on Thursday night to spoil Cooper Flagg's return from injury.
headlines.shortLinkText: Magic beat Mavericks 115-114 on Wendell Carter Jr.'s last-second dunk to spoil Cooper Flagg's return

headlines.description: — Ace Bailey crashed Trae Young's Washington debut, scoring 21 of his career-high 32 points in the first half to lift the Utah Jazz to a 122-112 victory...
headlines.shortLinkText: Ace Bailey scores career-high 32 as Jazz top Wizards 122-112 in Trae Young's Washington debut

headlines.description: — Tyler Herro scored 25 points, Bam Adebayo added 21 and the Miami Heat beat Brooklyn 126-110 on Thursday night, sending the Nets to their 10th consecutive loss.
headlines.shortLinkText: Heat surge past the Nets 126-110 as Brooklyn’s skid reaches 10

events.name: Golden State Warriors at Houston Rockets

headlines.description: — Brandon Podziemski had 26 points, De'Anthony Melton added 23 and the short-handed Golden State Warriors outlasted the Houston Rockets 115-113 in overtime Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Short-handed Warriors edge Rockets 115-113 in overtime thriller

headlines.description: — Anthony Edwards scored 22 points, including an impressive two-handed slam over RJ Barrett, and the Minnesota Timberwolves beat the Toronto Raptors 115-107 on Thursday night for...
headlines.shortLinkText: Anthony Edwards' big slam over RJ Barrett sparks Timberwolves to 115-107 win over Raptors

events.name: Detroit Pistons at San Antonio Spurs

headlines.description: — Victor Wembanyama had 38 points, 16 rebounds and five blocks and the San Antonio Spurs never trailed in completing a sweep of Detroit, beating the Pistons 121-106 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wembanyama has 38 points and 16 rebounds in the Spurs' 121-106 win over the Pistons

headlines.description: — Collin Sexton scored 30 points and the Chicago Bulls held off the Phoenix Suns 105-103 on Thursday night for their second victory in three games following an 11-game losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bulls hold off the Suns 105-103 for their 2nd win in 3 games after an 11-game skid

events.name: Los Angeles Lakers at Denver Nuggets

headlines.description: — LeBron James broke Kareem Abdul-Jabbar's record for career field goals in the Los Angeles Lakers' 120-113 loss to Denver on Thursday...
headlines.shortLinkText: LeBron James breaks the NBA career field goals record in the Lakers' 120-113 loss to the Nuggets

events.name: New Orleans Pelicans at Sacramento Kings

headlines.description: — Zion Williamson had 23 points on 10-for-14 shooting, Trey Murphy III added 21 points and the New Orelans Pelicans beat the NBA-worst Sacramento Kings 133-123 on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Zion Williamson scores 23 as the Pelicans beat the Kings 133-123
